summary: SU Group Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing amendments to outstanding warrants (Warrant Amendments) with holders, reducing the exercise price from US$0.87 to US$0.70 per Class A ordinary share (post 1-for-5 reverse split, from US$4.35). The number of warrant shares increased to approximately 42.7 million to preserve aggregate exercise proceeds of about US$29.9 million. Board approved the amendments considering capital needs and dilution. Warrants were issued in the May 2026 public offering. Exercise limited by registration coverage. Watch for future exercises and potential dilution.
